name: La Joyosa (Spain)
description: Red field with a blue horizontal stripe edged yellow across the centre, charged at the upper hoist with a yellow olive branch and flowers.
history: Municipal flag of La Joyosa; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

edges of the stripe and olive branch with flowers at the upper hoist
